_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: OCR A Level Further Mathematics A (H245) specification, sections 2c-2g (OCR reference codes 4.01a-8.06b)
_items_source.version: Version 2 (October 2025), downloaded from ocr.org.uk and itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: The specification's own OCR reference codes, one item per code: Pure Core 4.01a-4.10h (81), Statistics 5.01a-5.09e (51), Mechanics 6.01a-6.06a (42), Discrete Mathematics 7.01a-7.08f and Additional Pure Mathematics 8.01a-8.06b (124, declared out of scope because this course takes the Statistics and Mechanics options). 298 codes in all.
